repo_meta_data.description: Dumb-as-rocks OHLC analyzer. POST your bars + the indicators you want, get back exactly what you asked for. RSI/MACD/Bollinger/ADX/ATR/VWAP/Ichimoku, plus SMC primitives: Order Blocks, FVGs, BOS/CHoCH, swing structure. Stateless HTTP + MCP, no database, no AI-powered signals, no $97/mo Discord upsell.
